/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, date
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from collections import Counter

root=Path('/tmp/spring-reconciliation')
pages=json.loads((root/'pages.json').read_text())
customers=json.loads((root/'customers.json').read_text())
candidate=json.loads((root/'candidate.json').read_text())
assert [p['page'] for p in pages] == list(range(1, pages[0]['total_pages']+1))
assert all(p['total_pages']==len(pages) for p in pages)
assert all(p['next']==f'/orders?page={i+2}' for i,p in enumerate(pages[:-1]))
assert pages[-1]['next'] is None
listings=[o for p in pages for o in p['items']]
frequencies=Counter(o['id'] for o in listings)
unique={o['id']:o for o in listings}
assert all(o==unique[o['id']] for o in listings)
duplicates=sum(n-1 for n in frequencies.values())
regions=dict.fromkeys(('north','south','east','west'),0)
count=0
for order in unique.values():
    utc_date=datetime.fromisoformat(order['placed_at'].replace('Z','+00:00')).astimezone(timezone.utc).date()
    if order['status']=='shipped' and date(2025,3,1)<=utc_date<=date(2025,5,31):
        customer=customers[order['customer_id']]
        amount=(Decimal(order['amount_cents'])*(Decimal(100)-Decimal(customer['discount_pct']))/Decimal(100)).quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        regions[customer['region']]+=int(amount)
        count+=1
expected={'total_cents':sum(regions.values()),'order_count':count,'duplicates_skipped':duplicates,'by_region':regions}
assert candidate==expected, (candidate,expected)
assert set(candidate)=={'total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region'}
assert set(candidate['by_region'])=={'north','south','east','west'}
assert all(type(candidate[k]) is int for k in ('total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped'))
assert all(type(v) is int for v in candidate['by_region'].values())
assert sum(candidate['by_region'].values())==candidate['total_cents']
output=Path('/workspace/result.json')
output.write_text(json.dumps(candidate,indent=2)+'\\n')
assert json.loads(output.read_text())==expected
print('Independent Decimal and UTC calendar-date verification passed.')
print(output.read_text())
